summary: Postinstall beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package ships a beacon.cjs that is invoked both from the postinstall lifecycle hook and from the main entry on require(). The beacon POSTs a JSON payload containing os.hostname(), __dirname (install path), process.cwd(), and the Node/npm version to the hardcoded bare-IP destination http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plain HTTP. The destination is not configurable and is unrelated to any documented publisher infrastructure. The remainder of the package is a stub: index.js exports a Proxy of no-op functions and the package description is 'Compatibility shim.', so the beacon is the sole functional behavior shipped. The scope name mimics a web-components namespace, consistent with a dependency-confusion / namespace-squat lure whose only effect on install is calling out to the hardcoded endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
